sources.title: Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B | vLLM Recipes - recipes.vllm.ai
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-0.8B is the smallest member of the Qwen3.5 family — same hybrid gated delta networks architecture and 262K context, at a size suited to edge devices or as a draft model for speculative decoding with larger Qwen3.5 checkpoints.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-0.8B - Qualcomm AI Hub
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-0.8B Ultra‑compact 0.8B parameter model from the Qwen3.5 series for edge deployment. Qwen3.5 is the latest multilingual language model series from Alibaba Cloud with improved reasoning and instruction‑following capabilities over Qwen3.

sources.title: GitHub - jprbom/Qwen3.5: Qwen3.5 is the large language model series ...
sources.snippet: The official Qwen API is provided by Alibaba Cloud Model Studio. Alibaba Cloud Model Studio provides first-class support for Qwen3.5, which is compatible with various API specifications, including OpenAI and Anthropic, making it simple for you to try Qwen3.5 in your own applications.

sources.title: Qwen3.5 0.8B - Jetson AI Lab
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5 0.8B is the smallest vision-language model in the Qwen3.5 lineup. It is designed for lightweight local multimodal inference, fast iteration, and efficient Jetson deployment.
